data.notes: June’s confirmed music calendar around Split is anchored by Croatian pop programming at Galerija Meštrović, with a few regional live-music picks just outside the city.

events.title: Melodije Jadrana Split 2026
events.summary: Melodije Jadrana Split 2026 is confirmed for 25–28 June 2026 at Galerija Meštrović. The program includes Ricchi e Poveri, Jelena Rozga, Zorica Kondža with Joško Banov Acoustic Orchestra, and the Hit Ljeta new-songs night.

events.title: Yacht Week Rhythm & Waves Croatia
events.venueName: Croatia Original Route from the Split/Trogir sailing hub
events.summary: A week-long Yacht Week takeover on the Croatia route with hand-picked DJs, floating DJ decks, raft parties and a soundtrack centered on hip-hop, reggaeton, soca, dancehall, moombah and Afrobeats.

events.title: Podzemlje pres. Killa P @ Klub Kocka, Split
events.summary: Podzemlje closes the Platformat festival season at Klub Kocka with UK grime/dubstep figure Killa P, plus DMT, Spooky M and resident Anatolija; a notable bass-led booking for Split's underground club circuit.

events.title: XVIII. Metno Festival – Makarska
events.summary: The 18th Metno Festival runs 19–20 June 2026 in Makarska with a world/ethno lineup including Veja, Lucia de Carvalho, BCUC, Dubioza Kolektiv, DJ Tondini and VJ Lina Rica. The official Makarska tourist-board listing also confirms a 20 June party boat program.

events.title: Goran Karan | 'Oćeš doć? | Porat, Split 2026
events.summary: Split pop singer Goran Karan plays Porat Club Split on 5 June 2026, with the ticketing page listing the event as running 05.06.2026–06.06.2026. The listing confirms the venue, start time, and ticket tiers.

events.title: All/One presents: Allan's Free Party vol. 3
events.summary: Free outdoor electronic gathering from All/One and Carnero in Split-Dalmatia, with Allan, El Commando, Carnero, Errortek, HyperLili, Jeans (NL), Karlita, Neurosystem, Matriark and Xer S]ne.

events.title: Split After Dark
events.venueName: Jimmy Bar / Split boat party / VIP club entry route
events.summary: Party Hard Travel's boat-to-club night pairs pre-drinks at Jimmy Bar with a live-DJ Split boat party and VIP club entry, aimed at international summer clubbing travelers rather than the arena/festival crowd.

events.title: Brkovi at Beerfest Dugopolje
events.summary: Regional punk-folk/rock band Brkovi are listed for Beerfest Dugopolje at Lokva Dračanica on 5 June 2026. Dugopolje is just outside Split, making this a nearby live-music pick rather than an in-city club event.
